data.one_liner: Shared sidekick commands, plugin engine, migrations, templates, and utilities for custom CLIs.
data.what_it_does: Provides shared commands, a plugin engine, migrations, and utilities for building customized project-scoped Dart CLIs. It includes prebuilt commands like analysis, formatting, dependency updates, and plugin management.
use_when: You are building a custom project-specific sidekick CLI in Dart
You want to share repetitive CLI tasks across your team using Dart commands instead of Bash scripts
avoid_when: You are building a standard mobile, web, or desktop user-facing application
You do not need a custom project CLI generator
strengths: Replaces complex bash scripts with testable and debuggable Dart code
Includes a rich set of prebuilt commands and an extensible plugin system
weaknesses: Requires using the sidekick ecosystem and generator
Major versions introduce breaking changes to core command execution
data.setup_notes: Activate the sidekick generator globally via pub and run sidekick init in your project directory.
